{"code": "import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Filter to converted customers
converted_customers = df[df['converted'] == 1]

# Exclude rows where customer_age is -1 (missing data)
valid_age_converted = converted_customers[converted_customers['customer_age'] != -1]

# Compute mean age
mean_age = valid_age_converted['customer_age'].mean()

# Print all required numbers
print(f'Number of converted customers: {len(converted_customers)}')
print(f'Number of converted customers with valid age (not -1): {len(valid_age_converted)}')
print(f'Mean age of converted customers with valid age: {mean_age}')
print(f'Rounded to two decimal places: {mean_age:.2f}')"}
